t: Gorilla Glue Double-Sided Mounting Tape provides a reliable solution for various fixing tasks. This 1.5m x 25mm strong adhesive tape creates an instant, crystal clear bond on both smooth and rough surfaces, making it ideal for workshops, general repairs, or securing items around the home. The low odour and solvent-free formulation offers a safer user experience, delivering a high-strength, long-lasting hold without the need for traditional fasteners.
